bridge.narrative: Liquid AI's June 27 LFM2.5-230M lands a sub-gigabyte on-device model against the full local-inference stack on day one, while Unsloth's v0.1.471-beta added LoRA/QLoRA for GLM-5.2 just two days after its weights dropped. Together the edge release and the proven two-day frontier turnaround make the same-week edge-tuning extrapolation the natural next step.
bridge.remaining_gap: No mainstream toolkit has yet landed same-week LoRA/QLoRA tuning for this specific sub-1B on-device checkpoint.
